long_biography.plain_text:
Acquiring Luna Park Sydney placed Bill Gravanis's Oscars Group in charge of one of Australia's best-known entertainment sites. As managing director, he described the landmark as a platform for expanding the company's hospitality and tourism business. The purchase extended a pattern of taking on established venues and combining food, accommodation and entertainment within a single operating group.

Development projects form another part of Gravanis's work. At Shell Cove, Oscars partnered on a waterfront hotel and apartment precinct, with Gravanis shaping the accommodation and food-and-beverage offer around the surrounding marina. The project combines a destination hotel, residential development and public hospitality spaces within one waterfront precinct.
